sn52.3:2.8: The exact sense of “lower”, “middle”, and “higher” _dhammas_ here is unclear.  Given the context of Anuruddha’s psychic powers, I follow Bodhi’s suggestion that we interpret in line with [an3.76]() understanding _dhamma_ = _dhatu_ = _loka_. I have preserved the parallelism in the translations, even though the terminology of the Pali is slightly different (dhamma vs. dhatu).
